title: AI Coding for Beginners: The Honest Guide to Getting Started in 2026
summary: Two types of beginners search 'AI coding': those who want to build apps and those who want to become developers. Both paths are valid—here's the right starting point for each.
body_markdown: Vibe coding means describing what you want in plain English and letting AI generate the entire application — you never write or read code yourself. AI-assisted coding means you write code yourself, with AI helping through autocomplete, suggestions, and error explanations. Vibe coding is for people who want to build products. AI-assisted coding is for developers who want to work faster and understand what they're building.
